description: Finds ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes and HCPCS Level II service, supply and drug codes whose official description matches words from a statement (everyday wording such as "flu shot" or "x-ray" is translated to the clinical terms), or whose code starts with the given characters. Use it when the statement prints a description but no code, or the code is partly illegible. CPT (5-digit) physician-service codes such as office visits and lab panels are not searchable because their text is licensed.

query.description: Words from a service or diagnosis description in everyday or clinical wording ("flu shot", "influenza vaccine administration", "type 2 diabetes"), or the start of a code ("E11", "J069").

name: search_codes
title: Search diagnosis and service codes
